component-plugin.name: SpaceSettingPermissionUpgradePlugin
component-plugin.description: Upgrade Space 'Settings' page access permission to be 'manager:/spaces/...' instead of '*:/spaces/...'

value-param.name: product.group.id
value-param.description: The groupId of the product

value-param.name: plugin.upgrade.target.version
value-param.description: The plugin target version (will not be executed if previous version is equal or higher than 6.5.0)

value-param.name: space.node.names
value-param.description: The plugin will set the icons of these space nodes names

value-param.name: space.node.icons
value-param.description: The plugin will set the space nodes icons with these icons
value-param.value: fas fa-cog;fas fa-users;fas fa-clipboard;fas fa-tasks;fas fa-wallet

value-param.name: plugin.execution.order
value-param.description: The plugin execution order

value-param.name: plugin.upgrade.execute.once
value-param.description: The plugin must be executed only once

value-param.name: plugin.upgrade.async.execution
value-param.description: The plugin will be executed in an asynchronous mode
